 Flash floods hit several areas in Klang, Shah Alam
 By YASMIN ABDUL LATIF 
 Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026
 | 4:59 PM MYT

 Photos taken from Threads. 
 PETALING JAYA: Several areas in Shah Alam and Klang have been hit by flash floods following continuous heavy rain on Tuesday (Nov 17).
 Posts shared on social media showed several major roads inundated by floodwaters, disrupting traffic movement.
 Among the affected areas reported were Sections 7 and 14, as well as the Kesas Highway near the Kemuning Toll Plaza heading towards Klang.
 In one post, a Threads user highlighted flooding along the route from Klang towards Shah Alam, advising motorists to use an alternative route via Bandar Baru Klang.
 Another post reported that the road from Setia Alam towards Klang was also inundated.
 Videos shared online showed roads submerged in floodwaters amid heavy rain, with visibility for motorists also affected.
 Meanwhile, another post uploaded at about 4.40pm reported flooding in the vicinity of i-City Shah Alam.
 Several photographs and videos shared on social media also showed vehicles moving slowly through flooded roads.
